output.summary: High-consumption AMI read rejections cause estimated bills, driving dispute ticket volume to roughly twice the pre‑August baseline (E-01, E-11). Evidence shows dispute tickets rose from ~600 to ~1,200 per month (E-01) and most disputed estimated bills are rejected for high consumption (E-11, E-12). The release includes a targeted customer outreach program for high‑consumption users (SH‑CS) and daily monitoring of disputed estimated bills via import status (DA‑BILL), with the monitoring work item marked DONE. Release was granted with known limitations because the DEFINE Gate resulted in CONDITIONAL_PASS, indicating outreach alone may not sufficiently reduce rejections and threshold adjustment remains deferred (VOB‑U‑U4 open). Outreach may insufficiently lower high‑consumption rejections, and the billing import threshold adjustment remains deferred (VOB‑U‑U4) and outside the current release scope.
